name: Distribution Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies whether the proceeds of the event will be distributed on a rolling basis rather than on a specific date.

ONGO.name: Ongoing
ONGO.definition: Event is ongoing for acceptance on an unsolicited basis.

ROLL.name: Rolling Basis
ROLL.definition: Event will have a number of acceptance and payment dates until further announcement by the Issuer or its agent.
